set_bonus.name: Set Bonus
set_bonus.description: Wearing a complete equipment set grants extra bonuses.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Takes 1 damage every 2 seconds for 30 seconds.

deadly_poison.name: Deadly Poison
deadly_poison.description: Takes 2 damage every 2 seconds for 30 seconds.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Restores 1 HP every 2 seconds for 30 seconds.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.description: Frozen solid — cannot act for 20 seconds.

resist-poison.name: Resist Poison
resist-poison.description: Reduces chance of being poisoned by 70% for 90 seconds.

fear.name: Fear
fear.description: Frozen with fear — cannot act for 20 seconds.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Roots slow your movement — attack speed halved for 15 seconds.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Fallen into magical slumber — cannot act or move.

trapped.name: Trapped
trapped.description: Caught in a trap — the party cannot move for 10 seconds, but can still attack and use skills.

invincibility.name: Invincibility
invincibility.description: The entire party cannot take damage for 60 seconds.

unseen.name: Unseen
unseen.description: The party is cloaked in shadow — monsters cannot see or attack them, and the party can pass through enemies. Breaks instantly on any action other than moving.

stun.name: Stun
stun.description: Stunned by a heavy blow — cannot act for 5 seconds.

resist-fear.name: Resist Fear
resist-fear.description: Reduces chance of being feared by 70% for 90 seconds.

shell.name: Shell
shell.description: A magical barrier that reduces all elemental damage taken by 10% for 60 seconds.

resist-fire.name: Resist Fire
resist-fire.description: Reduces fire damage taken by 30% for 30 seconds.

resist-ice.name: Resist Ice
resist-ice.description: Reduces ice damage taken by 30% for 30 seconds.

resist-lightning.name: Resist Lightning
resist-lightning.description: Reduces lightning damage taken by 30% for 30 seconds.

resist-water.name: Resist Water
resist-water.description: Reduces water damage taken by 30% for 30 seconds.

encumbered.name: Encumbered
encumbered.description: Carrying more than maximum weight — party movement halved.

overloaded.name: Overloaded
overloaded.description: Carrying more than twice maximum weight — party cannot move.
